Resolves #18037

Refs #17540

A new guide, `learn/guides/testing/DockLayoutsTesting.md`, teaches how to test and debug DockLayouts by the place a fact lives — the committed document, the projected component tree, the delivered VDOM, the painted DOM and main-thread geometry, and physical windows — and which tier or Neural Link tool can see each. It is registered under Testing in `learn/tree.json` and in the SEO `PRIORITIES` input, and linked from the Dock Layouts overview.

No residual beyond the cross-family whole-guide review this PR requests.

### 🔬 Depth Floor
**R1 — Measurement source versus worker visibility.** At `DockLayoutsTesting.md:11`, “a position no worker can see” conflicts with this head's `src/main/addon/WindowPosition.mjs:250`: publishGeometry sends getWindowData to the App worker. `src/manager/Window.mjs` stores the reported geometry and derives innerRect/outerRect. The existing `WindowGeometryRealChromeNL.spec.mjs:51` reads those rects from that manager through Neural Link and compares them to CDP bounds. Workers cannot measure native windows directly; they can observe published geometry. The matrix at line 50 also needs a bounded limitation in place of “Nothing above it — it is the last word”: headed execution permits physical observation but does not make that observation proof of every earlier state.

**R2 — Serial execution does not exclude retained state.** Lines 269–271 infer timing/load rather than shared state from one-worker serial whitebox execution. At this exact head, `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:19` retains neuralLinkModulesPromise; lines 57–89 cache the imported service modules, and the test fixture starts the shared ConnectionService at line 177. Its final step is await use(nl), not reconstruction of those module singletons. The scheduler settings in `playwright.config.e2e.mjs` remove concurrent test execution; they are not a reset boundary. Load sensitivity is evidence, not a diagnosis that excludes state retention.

**Rhetorical-Drift Audit — Findings:** Two overclaims in the observation model. The rest of the narrative can stay.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes
- **[RETROSPECTIVE]** Separate where a measurement originates, where it is published, and what a witness proves; serial order and state isolation are separate properties.
